_comment: Copy to aitools_config.json (same folder) and edit. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_work_dir: Cache, converted DXFs, renders, logs. Default %LOCALAPPDATA%\HvacAiCad\work
_drawing_dirs: Folders searched for DWG/DXF by file name; relative to the repo root.
_privacy: normal | redact (client texts masked) | numbers_only (no texts, no images). A tool call may only ask for a stricter level than this.
_acad_order: AutoCAD versions tried for DWG to DXF with accoreconsole, first installed wins.
